text:
olivia: @channel Quick GA note: Hosted Gen API v3 is live for production. Streaming, tool-calling, and the new high-quality variant redwood-summit-3 are enabled. Also shipping a cost-optimized quant variant mosaic-econ-quant. Deprecation window for /v2 gen endpoints: 75 days. Please read the short ops checklist below. :tada:

raj: Amazing—congrats team. Any changes to auth or headers?

olivia: No auth changes. Keep using API keys. New optional fields: `model_variant`, `streaming`, `tool_calls`. Example quick-test request in curl below.

marta: Docs: migration guide + example payloads pushed to staging docs (preview link shortly). SDK streaming helpers will be a small patch.

docs-bot: Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/v3-ga-preview (pr #621)

kevin: Rollout plan: short canary 1% -> 15% -> 60% over ~3h with health gates. Autoscale tuned for summit-3 memory profile. Canary keys via DM.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started canary for gen-pool-summit at 1876543320

anya: SRE notes: added dashboards for gen.latency.{p50,p95}, stream.open_sessions, toolcall.error_rate, cache.hit_percent. New alerts: gen.p95 > 650ms OR toolcall.error_rate > 0.6% -> page oncall. Synthetic streaming probe every 45s.

sam: Legal heads-up: customers enabling tool-calls must declare external tool scopes in console. Privacy text and consent flow queued.

kevin: Quick curl example for smoke test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/gen \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-summit-3","model_variant":"hq","streaming":true,"input":"Summarize this design brief"}'
```

olivia: Failover: automatic fallback to mosaic-econ-quant is enabled for routes that opt in. Rollback path: flip routing feature flag or route traffic back to v2 group; target full rollback < 30 minutes. Ops will monitor the first 6 hours closely. Ping #eng-oncall and tag @anya for issues. :rocket:
